🎵 RhythmTap

Musical notes fall in time with a beat and you must tap them as they reach the target line. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Tap buttons or keys when falling notes reach the bottom target line.
  2. Perfect timing gives bonus points and builds your combo.
  3. Miss too many notes and your combo resets.
  4. The beat speeds up at higher difficulty levels.
  5. Listen for the rhythm — audio cues help anticipate the beat.
